akhfash:14-14.t:
And He said ﴿أَحْسَنُ ٱلْخَالِقِينَ﴾ because the creators (الخالقين) are the makers. The poet said [in the kāmil metre; this is poetic witness no. 253]:
* وَأَرَاكَ تَغْرِي ماخَلَقْتَ وَبعْضُ القَوْمِ يَخْلُقُ ثم لاَ يَغْرِي *
(And I see you cut through what you have measured out, while some people measure out and then do not cut.)

akhfash:20-20.t: And He said ﴿وَشَجَرَةً تَخْرُجُ﴾ (conjoined) on "So We produced gardens", ﴿وَشَجَرَةً﴾ (and a tree).

akhfash:52-52.t: He said ﴿وَإِنَّ هَـٰذِهِ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً﴾ and put ﴿أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً﴾ in the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). Some read ﴿أُمَّتَكُم أُمَّةٌ واحدةٌ﴾, (the first) as a badal (substitute), with ﴿أُمَّةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ﴾ in the nominative as the khabar (predicate).

akhfash:61-61.t: And He said ﴿هُمْ لَهَا سَابِقُونَ﴾: He means "for its sake".

akhfash:64-64.t: And He said ﴿إِذَا هُمْ يَجْأَرُونَ﴾: from "جَأَرَ" "يَجْأَرُ" "جُؤاراً" and "جَأْراً" (to cry out).

akhfash:66-66.t: And He said ﴿عَلَىٰ أَعْقَابِكُمْ تَنكِصُونَ﴾ and ﴿تَنكُصْون﴾, like ﴿يَعْكِفُون﴾ and ﴿يعكِفون﴾. «[Translator's note: the two forms of the second pair are printed identically in the source; the intended contrast is يَعْكِفُون / يَعْكُفُون.]»

akhfash:108-108.t: And He said ﴿ٱخْسَئُواْ فِيهَا﴾ because it is from "خَسَأَ" "يَخْسَأْ"; you say: "خَسَأَتُهُ" (I drove him away) "فـخَسَأَ" (and he was driven away).

akhfash:114-114.t:
And He said ﴿إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلاَّ قَلِيلاً﴾, i.e. you stayed only a little. In the reading of Ibn Masʿūd: ﴿إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ لَقَلِيلاً﴾. The poet said [in the kāmil metre; this is poetic witness no. 254]:
هَبَلَتْكَ أُمُّكَ إِنْ قَتَلْتَ لَمُسْلِماً * وَجَبَتْ عَلَيْكَ عُقُوبَةُ المُتَعَمِّدِ
(May your mother be bereaved of you! You have indeed killed a Muslim; the punishment of the deliberate killer is due upon you.)

daas-irab:107-109.t: [ ﴿رَبَّنا﴾: munādā (the one addressed in the vocative) with an omitted vocative particle, accusative (manṣūb); and نا is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَخْرِجْنا﴾: a verb of supplication and its fāʿil (agent); the clause, together with what precedes it, has no grammatical position because it is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿مِنْها﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أخرجنا. ﴿فَإِنْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction and إن is conditional. ﴿عُدْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is initial. ﴿فَإِنَّا﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); إنّا is a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters) and نا is its noun; the clause is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis of the condition. ﴿ظالِمُونَ﴾: khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural. [ ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿اخْسَؤُا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فِيها﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اخسؤوا. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and لا is prohibitive. ﴿تُكَلِّمُونِ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the nūn; the nūn is the nūn of protection (lil-wiqāya), and the omitted yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). [ ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: إن and its noun; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿كانَ فَرِيقٌ﴾: كان (of kāna and its sisters) and its noun; the clause is the khabar. ﴿مِنْ عِبادِي﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to فريق. ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كان. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿آمَنَّا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿فَاغْفِرْ لَنا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a verb of supplication whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined; and لنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اغفر. ﴿وَارْحَمْنا﴾: conjoined to فاغفر, and نا is the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَأَنْتَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and [أنت is] mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿خَيْرُ﴾: khabar. ﴿الرَّاحِمِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:110-113.t: ﴿فَاتَّخَذْتُمُوهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the hāʾ is its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the wāw is for prolongation (lil-ishbāʿ); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿سِخْرِيًّا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit and of the genitive. ﴿أَنْسَوْكُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its first object. ﴿ذِكْرِي﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَكُنْتُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and كان (of kāna and its sisters) and its noun; the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تضحكون. ﴿تَضْحَكُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كان. ﴿إِنِّي﴾: إن and its noun; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿جَزَيْتُهُمُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the khabar of إني. ﴿الْيَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), attached to جزيتهم. ﴿بِما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition; ما is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun). ﴿صَبَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; [ما] and what follows it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the position of genitive by the bāʾ. ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾: أنّ and its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿هُمُ﴾: a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْفائِزُونَ﴾: the khabar of أنهم, nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَمْ﴾: an interrogative noun, an adverb of time attached to لبثتم. ﴿لَبِثْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to لبثتم. ﴿عَدَدَ﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿سِنِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is treated like (mulḥaq bi-) the sound masculine plural. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَبِثْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿يَوْماً﴾: an adverb of time, attached to لبثنا. ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿بَعْضَ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to يوما. ﴿يَوْمٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَسْئَلِ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿الْعادِّينَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:114-116.t: ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿إِنْ لَبِثْتُمْ﴾: إن is conditional, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لَوْ﴾: a conditional particle that does not make the verb jussive. ﴿أَنَّكُمْ﴾: أنّ and its noun; the clause has no position. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: كان (of kāna and its sisters) and its noun; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of أنكم. ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كنتم. ﴿أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ﴾: the hamza is interrogative, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنَّما﴾: [أنّ and ما,] the restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa); it and what follows it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) that stands in place of the two objects of حسب. ﴿خَلَقْناكُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿عَبَثاً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial) or mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَأَنَّكُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and أنّ and its noun. ﴿إِلَيْنا﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ترجعون; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿لا تُرْجَعُونَ﴾: لا is negating, and a passive imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar. ﴿فَتَعالَى اللَّهُ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and a past verb, with the Name of Majesty as its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الْمَلِكُ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of Allah. ﴿الْحَقُّ﴾: a second adjective. ﴿لا إِلهَ﴾: لا is the lā of generic negation, which operates like إنّ, and إله is its noun. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction. ﴿هُوَ﴾: badal (substitute). ﴿رَبُّ﴾: the khabar of لا. ﴿الْعَرْشِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْكَرِيمِ﴾: an adjective.

daas-irab:117-118.t: ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and من is a conditional [noun], mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَدْعُ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَعَ﴾: an adverb of place (ẓarf makān), attached to (mutaʿalliq) يدع. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِلهاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿آخَرَ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿لا بُرْهانَ﴾: لا is the lā of generic negation, and برهان is its noun. ﴿لَهُ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿بِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar; the clause is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya). ﴿فَإِنَّما﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and إنما is the restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿حِسابُهُ﴾: mubtadaʾ, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عِنْدَ رَبِّهِ﴾: an adverb attached to the omitted khabar, and a muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of the condition. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿لا﴾: negating. ﴿يُفْلِحُ الْكافِرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of إنه. ﴿وَقُلْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: munādā (the one addressed in the vocative) with an omitted vocative particle, accusative (manṣūb) as a vocative, and the yāʾ of the first person is omitted for lightness. ﴿اغْفِرْ﴾: a verb of supplication whose fāʿil is omitted; the clause of supplication is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). [Translator's note: the source says "omitted" (maḥdhūf); elsewhere the fāʿil of such verbs is described as latent (mustatir).] ﴿وَارْحَمْ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to اغفر, and parsed like it. ﴿وَأَنْتَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); أنت is mubtadaʾ. ﴿خَيْرُ﴾: khabar; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿الرَّاحِمِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:1-7.t: ﴿قَدْ﴾: a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿أَفْلَحَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, naʿt (adjective) of المؤمنون. ﴿هُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِي صَلاتِهِمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) after them. ﴿خاشِعُونَ﴾: khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and الذين is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the الذين before it. ﴿هُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَنِ اللَّغْوِ﴾: attached to the postponed khabar. ﴿مُعْرِضُونَ﴾: khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is ṣila. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِلزَّكاةِ فاعِلُونَ﴾: الذين is conjoined to what precedes; هم is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is فاعلون, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to it; the clause is ṣila. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حافِظُونَ﴾: والذين is conjoined to the الذين before it; هم is mubtadaʾ and حافظون its khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar; the clause is ṣila. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿عَلى أَزْواجِهِمْ﴾: attached to حافظون; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) and the mīm is for the plural. ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿ما﴾: relative, conjoined to أزواجهم. ﴿مَلَكَتْ أَيْمانُهُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the tāʾ is for the feminine, the hāʾ is in the position of genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi and the mīm is for the plural; the clause is ṣila. ﴿فَإِنَّهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is causal (taʿlīliyya); إن and its noun; the clause is causal, with no grammatical position. ﴿غَيْرُ﴾: khabar. ﴿مَلُومِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿فَمَنِ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive and من is a jussive-governing conditional. ﴿ابْتَغى﴾: a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿وَراءَ﴾: an adverb of place, or mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: ذا is a demonstrative, muḍāf ilayhi; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾: the fāʾ binds the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); أولئك is mubtadaʾ: أولاء is a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿هُمُ العادُونَ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is the khabar of أولئك.

daas-irab:8-11.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the relative noun is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to what precedes it. ﴿هُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لِأَماناتِهِمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) راعون. ﴿وَعَهْدِهِمْ﴾: maʿṭūf to عهدهم, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). [Translator's note: so in the source; it is conjoined to أماناتهم.] ﴿راعُونَ﴾: khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: the relative noun is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿هُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَلى صَلَواتِهِمْ﴾: attached to يحافظون, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is ṣila (relative clause). ﴿يُحافِظُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is their khabar. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the kasra in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and the kāf is for address. ﴿هُمُ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْوارِثُونَ﴾: khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is the khabar of أولئك, and the clause أولئك etc. is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: relative, in the position of nominative as a naʿt (adjective) of الوارثون, or mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَرِثُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the clause is ṣila, with no grammatical position. ﴿الْفِرْدَوْسَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). ﴿هُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِيها﴾: attached to خالدون. ﴿خالِدُونَ﴾: khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position, or the khabar of الذين in the position of nominative.

daas-irab:12-16.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām occurs in the complement of an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿خَلَقْنَا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْإِنْسانَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنْ سُلالَةٍ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) خلقنا. ﴿مِنْ طِينٍ﴾: attached to a naʿt (adjective) of سلالة; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the complement of an oath. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿جَعَلْناهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and a first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿نُطْفَةً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فِي قَرارٍ﴾: attached to an omitted naʿt. ﴿مَكِينٍ﴾: naʿt of قرار. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿خَلَقْنَا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿النُّطْفَةَ﴾: first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَلَقَةً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَخَلَقْنَا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةً﴾: the two objects of خلقنا. ﴿فَخَلَقْنَا الْمُضْغَةَ عِظاماً﴾: the clause is conjoined, and its i'rab is like the preceding one. ﴿فَكَسَوْنَا الْعِظامَ لَحْماً﴾: its i'rab is like the preceding one. ﴿ثُمَّ أَنْشَأْناهُ خَلْقاً﴾: its i'rab is like the preceding one. ﴿آخَرَ﴾: naʿt of خلقنا. [Translator's note: so in the source; آخر is a naʿt of خلقا.] ﴿فَتَبارَكَ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; a past verb; the clause is resumptive. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿أَحْسَنُ﴾: badal (substitute); the clause is resumptive. ﴿الْخالِقِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿إِنَّكُمْ﴾: a particle resembling the verb, and the kāf is its noun. ﴿بَعْدَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to ميتون. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn in the position of genitive by annexation; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿لَمَيِّتُونَ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ميتون is the khabar (predicate) of إن, nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw; the clause is conjoined. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿إِنَّكُمْ﴾: إن and its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to تبعثون. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تُبْعَثُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إن.

daas-irab:17-20.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq), and the lām occurs in the complement of an omitted oath. ﴿خَلَقْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿فَوْقَكُمْ﴾: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) خلقنا, and the kāf is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation. ﴿سَبْعَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿طَرائِقَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote. ﴿وَما كُنَّا﴾: the wāw is the wāw of circumstance (ḥāl), ما is negative, كنا is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb and نا is its noun. ﴿عَنِ الْخَلْقِ﴾: attached to غافلين. ﴿غافِلِينَ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of كان, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ; the clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَأَنْزَلْنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾: attached to أنزلنا. ﴿ماءً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِقَدَرٍ﴾: attached to أنزلنا; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَأَسْكَنَّاهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the verbal clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: attached to أسكناه. ﴿وَإِنَّا﴾: the wāw of circumstance, and إن and its noun. ﴿عَلى ذَهابٍ﴾: attached to قادرون. ﴿بِهِ﴾: attached to ذهاب. ﴿لَقادِرُونَ﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and قادرون is khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿فَأَنْشَأْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَكُمْ بِهِ﴾: both are attached to أنشأنا. ﴿جَنَّاتٍ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿مِنْ نَخِيلٍ﴾: attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective). ﴿وَأَعْنابٍ﴾: conjoined. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿فِيها﴾: attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿فَواكِهُ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is a second naʿt of جنات. ﴿كَثِيرَةٌ﴾: naʿt of فواكه. ﴿وَمِنْها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and [the preposition and pronoun] are attached to تأكلون. ﴿تَأْكُلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَشَجَرَةً﴾: conjoined to جنات. ﴿تَخْرُجُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is a naʿt of شجرة. ﴿مِنْ طُورِ﴾: attached to تخرج. ﴿سَيْناءَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تَنْبُتُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِالدُّهْنِ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl; the clause is a second naʿt of شجرة. ﴿وَصِبْغٍ﴾: conjoined to دهن. ﴿لِلْآكِلِينَ﴾: attached to صبغ.

daas-irab:21-23.t: ﴿وَإِنَّ﴾: the wāw is resumptive and إن is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿لَكُمْ فِي الْأَنْعامِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿لَعِبْرَةً﴾: the lām is the lām of commencement (lām al-ibtidāʾ) for emphasis, and عبرة is the postponed noun of إن; the clause is resumptive. ﴿نُسْقِيكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ because of heaviness; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir) and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِمَّا﴾: من is a preposition and ما is relative; both attached to نسقيكم. ﴿فِي بُطُونِها﴾: attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause), and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلَكُمْ فِيها﴾: both are attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿مَنافِعُ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is conjoined. ﴿كَثِيرَةٌ﴾: naʿt (adjective) of منافع. ﴿وَمِنْها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and [the preposition and pronoun] are attached to تأكلون. ﴿تَأْكُلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَعَلَيْها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and عليها is attached to تحملون. ﴿وَعَلَى الْفُلْكِ﴾: conjoined to what precedes them, attached to تحملون. ﴿تُحْمَلُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the verbal clause is conjoined to what precedes it. [Translator's note: the brackets around these last three words are garbled in the source text; the Quranic words have been restored as ﴿وَعَلَيْها﴾, ﴿وَعَلَى الْفُلْكِ﴾ and ﴿تُحْمَلُونَ﴾.] ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām occurs in the complement of an implied oath, and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿أَرْسَلْنا نُوحاً﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلى قَوْمِهِ﴾: attached to أرسلنا, and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿فَقالَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿يا قَوْمِ﴾: يا is a vocative particle; قوم is the one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa implied on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person. ﴿اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿ما لَكُمْ﴾: ما is negative, and لكم is attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿مِنْ إِلهٍ﴾: من is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; إله is mubtadaʾ, genitive in wording and nominative in position. ﴿غَيْرُهُ﴾: naʿt of إله. ﴿أَفَلا﴾: the hamza is for interrogation and لا is negative. ﴿تَتَّقُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is the object of saying.

daas-irab:24-25.t: ﴿فَقالَ الْمَلَأُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as a naʿt (adjective) of الملأ. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ قَوْمِهِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ما هذا﴾: ما is negative, the hāʾ is for alerting (tanbīh), and ذا is the demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بَشَرٌ﴾: khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِثْلُكُمْ﴾: naʿt, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿يُرِيدُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is a second naʿt of بشر. ﴿أَنْ يَتَفَضَّلَ﴾: أن governs the accusative, and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb); أن and what follows it, of noun and predicate, are in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of يريد. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: attached to يتفضل. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لو is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿شاءَ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَأَنْزَلَ﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿مَلائِكَةً﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of لو. ﴿ما سَمِعْنا﴾: ما is negative; سمعنا is a past verb and fāʿil. ﴿بِهذا﴾: ذا is a demonstrative; both attached to سمعنا. ﴿فِي آبائِنَا﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾: naʿt of آبائنا, genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is the object of saying. ﴿إِنْ هُوَ﴾: إن is negative; هو is mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا رَجُلٌ﴾: إلا is a particle of restriction and رجل is khabar; the clause is the object of saying. ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿جِنَّةٌ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is in the position of nominative as a naʿt of رجل. ﴿فَتَرَبَّصُوا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿بِهِ﴾: attached to تربصوا. ﴿حَتَّى حِينٍ﴾: attached to تربصوا.

daas-irab:26-27.t:
﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed (munādā) with an omitted vocative particle; it is accusative (manṣūb); the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿انْصُرْنِي﴾: a verb of supplication; the fāʿil is latent, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya) and the yāʾ of the first person is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بِما﴾: [ما is] maṣdariyya, in the position of genitive (majrūr). ﴿كَذَّبُونِ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma; the wāw is fāʿil, the nūn is for protection, and the omitted yāʾ of the first person is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَأَوْحَيْنا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) أوحينا; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنِ﴾: a particle of explanation (tafsīr). ﴿اصْنَعِ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الْفُلْكَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is explicative (mufassira), with no grammatical position. ﴿بِأَعْيُنِنا﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and نا is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿وَوَحْيِنا﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to what precedes, and نا is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿فَإِذا﴾: an adverb for future time, putting its condition in the genitive and made accusative by its apodosis (jawāb). ﴿جاءَ أَمْرُنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَفارَ التَّنُّورُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَاسْلُكْ﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis of إذا; an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿فِيها﴾: attached to اسلك. ﴿مِنْ كُلٍّ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿زَوْجَيْنِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ because it is a dual. ﴿اثْنَيْنِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. [Translator's note: this analysis follows the reading مِن كُلِّ زَوْجَيْنِ without tanwīn; on the reading مِن كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ shown in the heading, زوجين is mafʿūl bihi and اثنين its naʿt.] ﴿وَأَهْلَكَ﴾: maʿṭūf to كل, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative as the excepted. [Translator's note: the Quranic word is مَنْ.] ﴿سَبَقَ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾: attached to سبق. ﴿الْقَوْلُ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and لا is prohibitive. ﴿تُخاطِبْنِي﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا; the fāʿil is latent, the nūn is for protection and the yāʾ of the first person is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي الَّذِينَ﴾: الذين is a relative noun in the position of genitive; both attached to تخاطبني. ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾: إن and its noun. ﴿مُغْرَقُونَ﴾: khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw; the clause is causal (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:28-30.t: ﴿فَإِذَا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إذا is an adverbial conditional. ﴿اسْتَوَيْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَنْتَ﴾: a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as tawkīd (emphasis) of the agent pronoun in استويت. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a relative noun conjoined to the fāʿil of استويت. ﴿مَعَكَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, and the kāf is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation. ﴿عَلَى الْفُلْكِ﴾: attached to استويت; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَقُلِ﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis of إذا; an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿الْحَمْدُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty; [the preposition and noun] are attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, badal (substitute) of the Name of Majesty. ﴿نَجَّانا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility; its fāʿil is latent and نا is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila of the relative, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنَ الْقَوْمِ﴾: attached to نجانا. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: a naʿt (adjective), genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿وَقُلْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed (munādā) with an omitted vocative particle; it is accusative (manṣūb) by the vocative; the clause is the object of saying. ﴿أَنْزِلْنِي﴾: a verb of supplication whose fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "أنت"; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya) and the yāʾ of the first person is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مُنْزَلًا﴾: "mafʿūl bihi muṭlaq" [so in the source; i.e. a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object)]. ﴿مُبارَكاً﴾: its naʿt. ﴿وَأَنْتَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; أنت is mubtadaʾ. ﴿خَيْرُ﴾: khabar. ﴿الْمُنْزِلِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ; the clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾: ذا is a demonstrative in the position of genitive; both attached to the omitted fronted khabar of إن; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿لَآياتٍ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and آيات is the noun of إن, accusative with the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: إنّ, lightened (mukhaffafa) and inoperative (muhmala). ﴿كُنَّا﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and نا is its noun. ﴿لَمُبْتَلِينَ﴾: the lām distinguishing between negation and affirmation (al-lām al-fāriqa), and مبتلين is the khabar of كان, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:31-34.t: ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿أَنْشَأْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنشأنا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined. ﴿قَرْناً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿آخَرِينَ﴾: naʿt (adjective) of قرنا. ﴿فَأَرْسَلْنا فِيهِمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿فِيهِمْ﴾: attached to أرسلنا. ﴿رَسُولًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: attached to an omitted naʿt of رسولا; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنِ﴾: explicative (mufassira). ﴿اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is explicative. ﴿ما﴾: negative. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: attached to the omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿إِلهٍ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), genitive in wording and nominative in position; the clause is resumptive. ﴿غَيْرُهُ﴾: naʿt of إله. ﴿أَفَلا﴾: the hamza is for interrogation and لا is negative. ﴿تَتَّقُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil. ﴿وَقالَ الْمَلَأُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ قَوْمِهِ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive (majrūr) as a naʿt of قومه. [Translator's note: so in the source; الذين is more commonly parsed as a naʿt of الملأ, in the position of nominative.] ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَكَذَّبُوا﴾: conjoined to what precedes it, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿بِلِقاءِ﴾: attached to كذبوا. ﴿الْآخِرَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَتْرَفْناهُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي الْحَياةِ﴾: attached to أترفناهم. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾: a naʿt of الحياة, genitive with the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility. ﴿ما هذا﴾: ما is negative, the hāʾ is for alerting (tanbīh), and ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا بَشَرٌ﴾: إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr) and بشر is khabar. ﴿مِثْلُكُمْ﴾: naʿt of بشر; the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿يَأْكُلُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is a second naʿt. ﴿مِمَّا﴾: من is a preposition and ما is relative; both attached to يأكل. ﴿تَأْكُلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is ṣila. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: attached to تأكلون. ﴿وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿وَلَئِنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām prepares for the omitted oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam), and إن is a jussive-governing conditional particle. ﴿أَطَعْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿بَشَراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِثْلَكُمْ﴾: naʿt, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّكُمْ﴾: إن and its noun. ﴿إِذاً﴾: a particle of response. ﴿لَخاسِرُونَ﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and a khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is the complement of the oath, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:35-39.t: ﴿أَيَعِدُكُمْ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنَّكُمْ﴾: أن and its noun, and what follows it is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as second mafʿūl bihi of يعدكم. ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) مخرجون. ﴿مِتُّمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَكُنْتُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; كان and its noun. ﴿تُراباً﴾: khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَعِظاماً﴾: conjoined to ترابا. ﴿أَنَّكُمْ﴾: tawkīd (emphasis) of the first أنكم. ﴿مُخْرَجُونَ﴾: khabar of the first أنكم, nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿هَيْهاتَ﴾: a verbal noun of the past (ism fiʿl māḍin). ﴿هَيْهاتَ﴾: tawkīd. ﴿لِما﴾: the lām is redundant (zāʾida), and ما is relative, the fāʿil of هيهات. ﴿تُوعَدُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنْ﴾: a particle of negation. ﴿هِيَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِلَّا حَياتُنَا﴾: إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and حياتنا is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾: a naʿt (adjective), genitive (majrūr) with the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility. [Translator's note: الدنيا here is a naʿt of the nominative حياتنا; the source says "genitive".] ﴿نَمُوتُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَنَحْيا﴾: conjoined to نموت; it is an imperfect verb, nominative with the ḍamma implied on the alif because of impossibility, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is the Ḥijāzī negative, operating like ليس. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾: the noun of ما, in the position of nominative. ﴿بِمَبْعُوثِينَ﴾: the bāʾ is redundant, and a khabar, genitive in wording and accusative in position; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a particle of negation. ﴿هُوَ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا رَجُلٌ﴾: a particle of restriction, and رجل is the khabar of هو. ﴿افْتَرى﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied on the alif because of impossibility; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by على; both attached to افترى. ﴿كَذِباً﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a naʿt of رجل. ﴿وَما نَحْنُ لَهُ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: conjoined to وما نحن بمبعوثين, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed (munādā) with an omitted vocative particle; it is accusative by the vocative, and the yāʾ of the first person was dropped for lightness; the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿انْصُرْنِي﴾: a verb of supplication; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is omitted; the clause is the object of saying. [Translator's note: elsewhere the source calls this fāʿil "latent".] ﴿بِما كَذَّبُونِ﴾: [the preposition and ما] are attached to انصرني; and a past verb and its fāʿil, the nūn being for protection, and the yāʾ of the first person dropped for lightness. The clause is ṣila, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:40-43.t: ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَمَّا﴾: عن is a preposition and ما is a relative noun; both attached to (mutaʿalliq) ليصبحن. [Translator's note: ما here is usually parsed as redundant (zāʾida), with قليل genitive by عن.] ﴿قَلِيلٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَيُصْبِحُنَّ﴾: the lām occurs in the complement of the oath; an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the omitted wāw of the plural is its noun, and the nūn of emphasis is a particle with no grammatical position. ﴿نادِمِينَ﴾: khabar (predicate), accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the complement of an oath. ﴿فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; a past verb, the tāʾ being for the feminine, and the hāʾ is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الصَّيْحَةُ﴾: a postponed fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَجَعَلْناهُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿غُثاءً﴾: its second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَبُعْداً﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿لِلْقَوْمِ﴾: attached to بعدا. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: a naʿt (adjective), genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is the complement of an oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿أَنْشَأْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ﴾: attached to أنشأنا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿قُرُوناً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿آخَرِينَ﴾: a naʿt, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿ما تَسْبِقُ﴾: ما is negative, and an imperfect verb. ﴿مِنْ أُمَّةٍ﴾: من is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and a fāʿil, genitive in wording and nominative in position; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَجَلَها﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:44-47.t: ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿أَرْسَلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined. ﴿رُسُلَنا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and نا is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿تَتْرا﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb) with the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility. ﴿كُلَّ ما﴾: an adverb containing the meaning of condition. ﴿جاءَ﴾: a past verb. ﴿أُمَّةً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿رَسُولُها﴾: a postponed fāʿil, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كَذَّبُوهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the apodosis of كلما, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَأَتْبَعْنا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بَعْضَهُمْ﴾: first mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بَعْضاً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَجَعَلْناهُمْ أَحادِيثَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; a past verb, its fāʿil and its two objects; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَبُعْداً لِقَوْمٍ لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: its i'rab has preceded in verse 41, and the clause لا يؤمنون is a naʿt (adjective) of قوم. ﴿ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنا مُوسى﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the fatḥa implied on the alif because of impossibility; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَأَخاهُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أخاه is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to موسى, accusative with the alif because it is one of the five nouns, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هارُونَ﴾: badal (substitute) of أخاه. ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) أرسلنا, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَسُلْطانٍ﴾: maʿṭūf to آيات. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾: naʿt. ﴿إِلى فِرْعَوْنَ﴾: attached to أرسلنا; فرعون is genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿وَمَلَائِهِ﴾: maʿṭūf to فرعون with the kasra, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَكانُوا﴾: كان and its noun. ﴿قَوْماً﴾: khabar (predicate). ﴿عالِينَ﴾: naʿt of قوما, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَقالُوا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنُؤْمِنُ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿لِبَشَرَيْنِ﴾: attached to نؤمن; the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مِثْلِنا﴾: naʿt, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَقَوْمُهُما﴾: the wāw is the wāw of circumstance (ḥāl), and a mubtadaʾ (subject); the hāʾ is muḍāf [ilayhi]. ﴿لَنا﴾: attached to عابدون. ﴿عابِدُونَ﴾: khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is circumstantial.

daas-irab:48-53.t: ﴿فَكَذَّبُوهُما﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَكانُوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; كان and its noun. ﴿مِنَ الْمُهْلَكِينَ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām occurs in the complement of an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿آتَيْنا مُوسَى﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾: لعل and its noun; the clause is causal (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position. ﴿يَهْتَدُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of لعل; the clause of the complement of the oath has no grammatical position. ﴿وَجَعَلْنَا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿ابْنَ﴾: first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مَرْيَمَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿وَأُمَّهُ﴾: conjoined to ابن, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿آيَةً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَآوَيْناهُما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلى رَبْوَةٍ﴾: attached to آويناهما. ﴿ذاتِ﴾: naʿt (adjective) of ربوة. ﴿قَرارٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَمَعِينٍ﴾: conjoined to قرار. ﴿يا أَيُّهَا﴾: يا is a vocative particle; أيها is an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of accusative (manṣūb), and the hāʾ is for alerting (tanbīh). ﴿الرُّسُلُ﴾: badal (substitute). ﴿كُلُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and its fāʿil, the alif being for distinction (al-alif al-fāriqa); the clause has no grammatical position because it is resumptive. ﴿مِنَ الطَّيِّباتِ﴾: attached to كلوا. ﴿وَاعْمَلُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. [Translator's note: اعملوا is an imperative verb; the source says "past".] ﴿صالِحاً﴾: naʿt of an omitted qualified noun, its implied form being "اعملوا عملا صالحا" (do righteous work). ﴿إِنِّي﴾: إن and its noun. ﴿بِما﴾: attached to عليم. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is ṣila (relative clause). ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾: khabar of إن. ﴿وَإِنَّ﴾: the wāw is resumptive and إن is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿هذِهِ﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable on the kasra in the position of accusative as the noun of إن; the hāʾ is for alerting. ﴿أُمَّتُكُمْ﴾: khabar of إن, and the kāf is in the position of genitive by annexation; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أُمَّةً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿واحِدَةً﴾: naʿt of أمة. ﴿وَأَنَا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿رَبُّكُمْ﴾: khabar, and the kāf is in the position of genitive by annexation; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿فَاتَّقُونِ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the omitted yāʾ of the first person is mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿فَتَقَطَّعُوا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; a past verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿أَمْرَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾: an adverb of place attached to تقطعوا; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿زُبُراً﴾: ḥāl. ﴿كُلُّ﴾: mubtadaʾ, [the clause] resumptive. ﴿حِزْبٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِما﴾: ما is a relative noun; both attached to فرحون. ﴿لَدَيْهِمْ﴾: an adverb of place attached to an omitted ṣila, and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿فَرِحُونَ﴾: khabar of the mubtadaʾ, nominative with the wāw; the clause has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:54-59.t: ﴿فَذَرْهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت"; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِي غَمْرَتِهِمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) ذرهم; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿حَتَّى حِينٍ﴾: attached to ذرهم. ﴿أَيَحْسَبُونَ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿أن﴾: a particle resembling the verb. ﴿ما﴾: ما is a relative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as its noun; أن, its noun and its khabar (predicate) stand in place of the two objects of حسب. ﴿نُمِدُّهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb; the fāʿil is latent and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِهِ﴾: attached to the verb; the clause is ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ مالٍ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَبَنِينَ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to مال, genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural. ﴿نُسارِعُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar of أن. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: attached to نسارع. ﴿فِي الْخَيْراتِ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿بَلْ﴾: a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿لا يَشْعُرُونَ﴾: لا is negative; an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هم". ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾: إن, and the relative noun is its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿هُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنْ خَشْيَةِ﴾: attached to مشفقون. ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مُشْفِقُونَ﴾: khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is the ṣila of the relative. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: conjoined to the first الذين. ﴿هُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِآياتِ﴾: attached to يؤمنون. ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is khabar. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: conjoined to the preceding الذين. ﴿هُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِرَبِّهِمْ﴾: attached to يشركون, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا يُشْرِكُونَ﴾: لا is negative; يشركون is an imperfect verb and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is khabar.

daas-irab:60-63.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: conjoined to the preceding الذين. ﴿يُؤْتُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿ما﴾: relative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿آتَوْا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَقُلُوبُهُمْ﴾: the wāw is the wāw of circumstance (ḥāl), and a mubtadaʾ (subject); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَجِلَةٌ﴾: khabar (predicate); the clause is circumstantial. ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾: أن and its noun. ﴿إِلى رَبِّهِمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) راجعون; the clause is causal (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position. ﴿راجِعُونَ﴾: khabar. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ, and the kāf is for address; the clause of mubtadaʾ and khabar is the khabar of الذين from verse 58 [Translator's note: so in the source; the الذين in question begins at verse 57]. ﴿يُسارِعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of أولئك. ﴿فِي الْخَيْراتِ﴾: attached to يسارعون. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَها﴾: attached to سابقون. ﴿سابِقُونَ﴾: khabar, nominative with the wāw. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is resumptive and لا is negative. ﴿نُكَلِّفُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿نَفْساً﴾: first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلَّا وُسْعَها﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and a second mafʿūl bihi; the hāʾ is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation. ﴿وَلَدَيْنا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and an adverb of place attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿كِتابٌ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿يَنْطِقُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of كتاب. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾: attached to ينطق. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and a mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا يُظْلَمُونَ﴾: لا is negative; a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is khabar. ﴿بَلْ﴾: a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿قُلُوبُهُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِي غَمْرَةٍ﴾: attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿مِنْ هذا﴾: ذا is a demonstrative, genitive by من; both attached to a naʿt of غمرة. ﴿وَلَهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; [the preposition and pronoun] are attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿أَعْمالٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾: attached to an omitted naʿt of أعمال. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿هُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿لَها﴾: attached to عاملون. ﴿عامِلُونَ﴾: khabar, nominative with the wāw; the clause confirms what precedes it, or is a naʿt of أعمال.

daas-irab:64-68.t: ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of commencement (ḥarf ibtidāʾ). ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb containing the meaning of condition. ﴿أَخَذْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مُتْرَفِيهِمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِالْعَذابِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) أخذنا. ﴿إِذا هُمْ﴾: إذا of surprise (al-fujāʾiyya), and هم is mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿يَجْأَرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is khabar (predicate). ﴿لا تَجْأَرُوا﴾: لا is prohibitive; an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿الْيَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to تجأروا. ﴿إِنَّكُمْ﴾: إن and its noun; the clause is causal (taʿlīl). ﴿مِنَّا﴾: attached to تنصرون. ﴿لا تُنْصَرُونَ﴾: لا is negative; a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar of إن. ﴿قَدْ كانَتْ﴾: قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); كان, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿آياتِي﴾: the noun of كان, nominative with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is causal. ﴿تُتْلى﴾: a passive imperfect verb, nominative with the ḍamma implied on the alif because of impossibility; the nāʾib fāʿil is implied; the clause is the khabar of كان. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: attached to تتلى. ﴿فَكُنْتُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; كان and its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَلى أَعْقابِكُمْ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of تنكصون. ﴿تَنْكِصُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is khabar. ﴿مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ﴾: ḥāl, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿بِهِ﴾: attached to مستكبرين. ﴿سامِراً﴾: ḥāl. ﴿تَهْجُرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿أَفَلَمْ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ is resumptive, and لم governs the jussive. ﴿يَدَّبَّرُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive, and the wāw is fāʿil. ﴿الْقَوْلَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَمْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿جاءَهُمْ﴾: a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ما لَمْ﴾: ما is a relative noun, fāʿil, and لم is a jussive particle. ﴿يَأْتِ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the weak letter; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿آباءَهُمُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of آباءهم, accusative with the yāʾ; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative.

daas-irab:69-72.t: ﴿أَمْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿لَمْ يَعْرِفُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil (agent). ﴿رَسُولَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; هم is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَهُ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) منكرون. ﴿مُنْكِرُونَ﴾: khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَمْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِهِ﴾: attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿جِنَّةٌ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بَلْ﴾: a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿جاءَهُمْ﴾: a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and a mubtadaʾ; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِلْحَقِّ﴾: attached to كارهون. ﴿كارِهُونَ﴾: khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿وَلَوِ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لو is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿اتَّبَعَ الْحَقُّ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَهْواءَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation; the clause has no grammatical position because it is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿لَفَسَدَتِ﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis of لو; a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿السَّماواتُ﴾: fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of لو. ﴿وَالْأَرْضُ﴾: conjoined to السموات. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, conjoined to السموات. ﴿فِيهِنَّ﴾: attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, and the nūn is a particle indicating the feminine plural. ﴿بَلْ﴾: a particle of digression. ﴿أَتَيْناهُمْ﴾: a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِذِكْرِهِمْ﴾: attached to أتيناهم, and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿فَهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction and هم is mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَنْ ذِكْرِهِمْ﴾: attached to معرضون, and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿مُعْرِضُونَ﴾: khabar of the mubtadaʾ, nominative with the wāw; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَمْ تَسْأَلُهُمْ﴾: a conjunction, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the hāʾ is first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿خَرْجاً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَخَراجُ﴾: the fāʾ is causal (taʿlīliyya), and a mubtadaʾ, which is muḍāf. ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾: khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the clause is causal (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾: the wāw is the wāw of circumstance (ḥāl); هو is a detached pronoun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾: khabar; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿الرَّازِقِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ.

daas-irab:73-77.t: ﴿وَإِنَّكَ﴾: the wāw is the wāw of circumstance (ḥāl); إن is a particle resembling the verb and the kāf is its noun; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿لَتَدْعُوهُمْ﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the wāw because of heaviness; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت", and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of إن. ﴿إِلى صِراطٍ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) تدعوهم. ﴿مُسْتَقِيمٍ﴾: naʿt (adjective) of صراط. ﴿وَإِنَّ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and إن is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the noun of إن. ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: لا is negative; an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِالْآخِرَةِ﴾: attached to يؤمنون. ﴿عَنِ الصِّراطِ﴾: attached to ناكبون. ﴿لَناكِبُونَ﴾: the lām is the shifted lām, and the khabar of إن. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لو is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿رَحِمْناهُمْ﴾: a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the verbal clause has no grammatical position because it is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿وَكَشَفْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِهِمْ﴾: attached to an omitted ṣila. ﴿مِنْ ضُرٍّ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لَلَجُّوا﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis of لو; a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis of "لولا", with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: so in the source; the apodosis is that of لو.] ﴿فِي طُغْيانِهِمْ﴾: attached to لجوا. ﴿يَعْمَهُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, the lām occurs in the complement of an oath, and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿أَخَذْناهُمْ﴾: a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the complement of an oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِالْعَذابِ﴾: attached to أخذناهم. ﴿فَمَا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction and ما is negative. ﴿اسْتَكانُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِرَبِّهِمْ﴾: attached to استكانوا, and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negative. ﴿يَتَضَرَّعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of commencement (ḥarf ibtidāʾ) with no grammatical position. ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb for future time, putting its condition in the genitive and made accusative by its apodosis. ﴿فَتَحْنا﴾: a past verb and fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: attached to فتحنا. ﴿باباً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ذا﴾: a naʿt of بابا, accusative with the alif because it is one of the five nouns. ﴿عَذابٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿شَدِيدٍ﴾: naʿt of عذاب. ﴿إِذا﴾: [the إذا] of surprise (al-fujāʾiyya). ﴿هُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِيهِ﴾: attached to مبلسون. ﴿مُبْلِسُونَ﴾: khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

daas-irab:78-83.t: ﴿وَهُوَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive and هو is a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, khabar (predicate). ﴿أَنْشَأَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿لَكُمُ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنشأ; the clause is ṣila (relative clause). ﴿السَّمْعَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَالْأَبْصارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ﴾: conjoined to what precedes. ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (nāʾib mafʿūl muṭlaq, standing in for the absolute object). ﴿ما تَشْكُرُونَ﴾: ما is maṣdariyya; an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause, interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), is the fāʿil of قليلا. ﴿وَهُوَ الَّذِي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; a mubtadaʾ, and the relative noun is its khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿ذَرَأَكُمْ﴾: a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is ṣila. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: attached to ذرأكم. ﴿وَإِلَيْهِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إليه is attached to تحشرون. ﴿تُحْشَرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, passive; the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يُحْيِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ because of heaviness, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is ṣila. ﴿وَيُمِيتُ﴾: conjoined to يحيي, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿وَلَهُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and [the preposition and pronoun] are attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿اخْتِلافُ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿اللَّيْلِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالنَّهارِ﴾: conjoined to الليل. ﴿أَفَلا﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ is resumptive and لا is negative. ﴿تَعْقِلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بَلْ﴾: a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِثْلَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation. ﴿قالَ الْأَوَّلُونَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, nominative with the wāw; the clause is ṣila. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَإِذا﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; إذا is an adverb containing the meaning of condition. ﴿مِتْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَكُنَّا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; كان and its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿تُراباً﴾: khabar. ﴿وَعِظاماً﴾: conjoined to ترابا. ﴿أَإِنَّا﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; إن and its noun. ﴿لَمَبْعُوثُونَ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and a khabar, nominative with the wāw; the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لَقَدْ﴾: the lām occurs in the complement of the oath, and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿وُعِدْنا﴾: a passive past verb, and نا is nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾: tawkīd (emphasis) of the nāʾib fāʿil نا. ﴿وَآباؤُنا﴾: conjoined to the nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿هذا﴾: the hāʾ is for alerting (tanbīh), and ذا is a demonstrative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾: attached to وعدنا. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a particle of negation with no governing effect. ﴿هذا﴾: the hāʾ is for alerting, and ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَساطِيرُ﴾: khabar. ﴿الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause of the complement of the oath has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:84-89.t:
﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِمَنِ﴾: the lām is a preposition and من is a relative noun; both attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate). [Translator's note: من here is interrogative; the source says "relative noun".] ﴿الْأَرْضُ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; من is a relative noun conjoined to الأرض. ﴿فِيها﴾: attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنْ﴾: a jussive-governing conditional particle. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: كان and its noun; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is khabar, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted. ﴿سَيَقُولُونَ﴾: the sīn is for the future; an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive (majrūr) by the lām; both attached to an omitted khabar, and the mubtadaʾ is omitted, its implied form being "هي لله" (it belongs to Allah); the clause is the object of saying. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَفَلا﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ is a conjunction and لا is negative. [Translator's note: the bracket of this word is broken in the source and has been restored.] ﴿تَذَكَّرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is the object of saying. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَنْ﴾: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿رَبُّ﴾: khabar. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿السَّبْعِ﴾: naʿt (adjective); the clause is the object of saying. ﴿وَرَبُّ﴾: conjoined to رب. ﴿الْعَرْشِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْعَظِيمِ﴾: naʿt. ﴿سَيَقُولُونَ﴾: the sīn is for the future; an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by the lām; both attached to the khabar of the omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هي لله"; the clause is the object of saying. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَفَلا﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ is a conjunction and لا is negative. ﴿تَتَّقُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the clause is the object of saying. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿مَنْ﴾: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ, and its clause is the object of saying. ﴿بِيَدِهِ﴾: attached to an omitted fronted khabar, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مَلَكُوتُ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ من. ﴿كُلِّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; هو is mubtadaʾ; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿يُجِيرُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is khabar. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is negative. ﴿يُجارُ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is omitted. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾: attached to يجار. ﴿إِنْ﴾: conditional. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: كان and its noun; the clause is initial. ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is khabar, and the apodosis is omitted.
﴿سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ قُلْ﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿فَأَنَّى﴾: the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and أنى is an interrogative noun, ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿تُسْحَرُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is the object of saying.

daas-irab:90-93.t: ﴿بَلْ﴾: a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿أَتَيْناهُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَإِنَّهُمْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; إن and its noun. ﴿لَكاذِبُونَ﴾: khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw, and the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause is circumstantial. ﴿مَا﴾: negative. ﴿اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿وَلَدٍ﴾: mafʿūl bihi in position. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negative. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿مَعَهُ﴾: an adverb of place attached to the omitted khabar, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant preposition. ﴿إِلهٍ﴾: the noun of كان, genitive (majrūr) in wording and nominative in position. ﴿إِذاً﴾: a particle of response. ﴿لَذَهَبَ كُلُّ﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis of لو [Translator's note: i.e. an implied لو]; a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿إِلهٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِما﴾: ما is relative; both attached to ذهب. ﴿خَلَقَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَلَعَلا﴾: conjoined to ذهب. ﴿بَعْضُهُمْ﴾: the fāʿil of علا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلى بَعْضٍ﴾: attached to علا. ﴿سُبْحانَ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, and its clause is resumptive. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَمَّا﴾: عن is a preposition and ما is a relative noun; both attached to سبحان. ﴿يَصِفُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is ṣila. ﴿عالِمِ﴾: badal (substitute) of the Name of Majesty. ﴿الْغَيْبِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالشَّهادَةِ﴾: conjoined to الغيب. ﴿فَتَعالى﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَمَّا﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿يُشْرِكُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is ṣila. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed (munādā) with an omitted vocative particle; it is accusative (manṣūb) by the vocative with the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, which was dropped for lightness; the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِمَّا﴾: composed of the conditional إن and the redundant ما. ﴿تُرِيَنِّي﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; it is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), the yāʾ is first mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يُوعَدُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is ṣila.

daas-irab:94-99.t: ﴿رَبِّ﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and لا is prohibitive. ﴿تَجْعَلْنِي﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya) and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿فِي الْقَوْمِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) تجعلني. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of قوم, genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ. ﴿وَإِنَّا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إن and its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَلى﴾: a preposition. ﴿أَنْ﴾: a maṣdar-forming particle governing the accusative. ﴿نُرِيَكَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and the kāf is first mafʿūl bihi; أن and what follows it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) whose position is genitive by على, both attached to قادرون. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿نَعِدُهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لَقادِرُونَ﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and the khabar (predicate) of إنا, nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw. ﴿ادْفَعْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِالَّتِي﴾: a relative noun; both attached to ادفع. ﴿هِيَ أَحْسَنُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar; the clause is ṣila. ﴿السَّيِّئَةَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَعْلَمُ﴾: khabar; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿بِما﴾: attached to أعلم. ﴿يَصِفُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; the clause is ṣila, and the wāw is fāʿil. ﴿وَقُلْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), muḍāf. ﴿أَعُوذُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). The meaning of أعوذ is "I seek protection". ﴿بِكَ﴾: attached to أعوذ. ﴿مِنْ هَمَزاتِ﴾: attached to أعوذ. ﴿الشَّياطِينِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَأَعُوذُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِكَ﴾: attached to أعوذ. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed with an omitted vocative particle, accusative with the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, which was dropped for lightness. ﴿أَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ﴾: أن governs the accusative, and an imperfect verb, accusative by أن, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the nūn is for protection, and the omitted yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit (ghāya) and a preposition. ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb containing the meaning of condition. ﴿جاءَ أَحَدَهُمُ الْمَوْتُ﴾: a past verb, its fronted mafʿūl bihi and its postponed fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed, muḍāf. ﴿ارْجِعُونِ﴾: a verb of supplication, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and the omitted yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the object of saying.

daas-irab:100-102.t: ﴿لَعَلِّي﴾: لعل and its noun; the clause is causal (taʿlīl). ﴿أَعْمَلُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿صالِحاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of لعل. ﴿فِيما﴾: ما is relative; both attached to (mutaʿalliq) صالحا. ﴿تَرَكْتُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is ṣila (relative clause). ﴿كَلَّا﴾: a particle of rebuke (zajr). ﴿إِنَّها كَلِمَةٌ﴾: إن, its noun and its khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿هُوَ قائِلُها﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of كلمة, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَمِنْ وَرائِهِمْ﴾: attached to an omitted fronted khabar, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بَرْزَخٌ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلى يَوْمِ﴾: attached to an omitted naʿt of برزخ. ﴿يُبْعَثُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَإِذا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and إذا is an adverb containing the meaning of condition. ﴿نُفِخَ﴾: a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil is latent. ﴿فِي الصُّورِ﴾: attached to نفخ; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis of إذا, and لا is the lā of generic negation, operating like إن. ﴿أَنْسابَ﴾: its noun. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾: attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾: an adverb annexed to one like it; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is negative. ﴿يَتَساءَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and من is a jussive-governing conditional, mubtadaʾ. ﴿ثَقُلَتْ مَوازِينُهُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the tāʾ is for the feminine and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾: the fāʾ binds the apodosis; أولاء is mubtadaʾ, the lām is for distance [Translator's note: so in the source; أولئك has no lām] and the kāf for address. ﴿هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is the khabar of أولئك, and the two clauses of condition and apodosis are the khabar of فمن.

daas-irab:103-106.t: ﴿وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوازِينُهُ فَأُولئِكَ﴾: its i'rab is like the i'rab of the preceding one. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar (predicate) of أولئك; the clause is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿خَسِرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فِي جَهَنَّمَ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the fronted khabar; جهنم is genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿خالِدُونَ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is a badal (substitute) of the ṣila of the relative. [Translator's note: so in the source; خالدون is usually parsed as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ "هم", with في جهنم attached to it.] ﴿تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ النَّارُ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fronted mafʿūl bihi and its postponed fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; هم is mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِيها﴾: attached to كالحون. ﴿كالِحُونَ﴾: khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿أَلَمْ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; لم governs the jussive. ﴿تَكُنْ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb. ﴿آياتِي﴾: the noun of تكن, nominative with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted قال. ﴿تُتْلى﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is khabar. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: attached to تتلى. ﴿فَكُنْتُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; كان and its noun. ﴿بِها﴾: attached to تكذبون; the clause is conjoined. ﴿تُكَذِّبُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كنتم. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾: the one addressed (munādā) with an omitted vocative particle, accusative (manṣūb), and نا is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the object of saying. ﴿غَلَبَتْ﴾: a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾: attached to the verb. ﴿شِقْوَتُنا﴾: fāʿil, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the object of saying. ﴿وَكُنَّا قَوْماً﴾: كان, its noun and its khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿ضالِّينَ﴾: a naʿt (adjective), accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

farraa:5-6.t:
His saying: ﴿وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَافِظُونَ﴾ ﴿لاَّ عَلَىٰ أَزْوَاجِهِمْ﴾ «[Translator's note: the quotation appears thus in the source; the Qurʾānic text is إِلَّا عَلَىٰ أَزْوَاجِهِمْ.]» — the meaning is: except from their wives whom Allah has made lawful, out of the four, not to be exceeded.
His saying: ﴿أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ﴾ — (ما) is in the position of the genitive (khafḍ). He is saying: there is no set limit on them regarding slave-women; they may take as many as they wish. That is His saying: they guarded their private parts except from these two [kinds], ﴿فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ﴾ in it — He is saying: not sinning.

farraa:11-11.t: His saying: ﴿ٱلْفِرْدَوْسَ﴾ — al-Kalbī said: it is "the garden" in the language of the Romans (al-Rūm). Al-Farrāʾ said: it is Arabic too; the Arabs call a garden al-firdaws.

farraa:12-12.t: His saying: ﴿مِن سُلاَلَةٍ﴾ — al-sulāla is that which is drawn out of every soil.

farraa:14-14.t:
His saying: ﴿فَكَسَوْنَا ٱلْعِظَامَ لَحْماً﴾ — also (العَظْمَ). In the reading of ʿAbdallāh it is ﴿ثم جَعَلنا النطفة عظماً وعَصَباً فكسوناه لحماً﴾, and this is evidence for whoever says ʿaẓman [in the singular]; some have indeed read it (عظما).
His saying: ﴿ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَاهُ خَلْقاً آخَرَ﴾ — it [the pronoun] refers to the human being; or, if you wish, to the bone, the sperm-drop and the sinew, treating them as a single thing.

farraa:15-15.t: His saying: ﴿بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ﴾ — it is read (لَميْتون) and (لمائتونَ), and mayyitūn is more common. The Arabs say to someone who has not died: "You are mayyit (going to die) shortly", and also māʾit. But they do not say of a dead man who has already died: "This is māʾit"; it is said only of the future and is not extended beyond the future. Likewise it is said: "This is the sayyid (lord) of his people today", and when you report that he will become their lord shortly, you say: "This one is sāʾid of his people shortly", and also sayyid. Likewise with greed: you say "He is ṭāmiʿ (hoping) for what you have, tomorrow"; but when «[Translator's note: manuscript folio marker 123b]» you describe him as [habitually] greedy you say: "He is ṭamiʿ".
